The test `test_apply_to_nullable_integer_returns_float(values, function)` checks whether applying the specified aggregation function to nullable integer columns returns a float. However, this is not the case when using the `apply` method of a DataFrameGroupBy object.

Following the execution path, we find that the `apply` method in pandas.core.groupby.groupby._GroupBy applies the user-specified function to each group in the grouped data. The error occurred because the specified aggregation function (in this case, `function`) is not compatible with the nullable integer columns in the DataFrameGroupBy object.

In particular, when using the `apply` method with an aggregation function that requires numerical operations, pandas attempts to cast the values in the nullable integer columns to the appropriate data type. However, if the values cannot be safely cast (e.g., because they are NaN), a TypeError is raised.

Consequently, the error demonstrated by the test indicates that the `apply` method is not handling nullable integer columns correctly when using an aggregation function that requires numerical operations.

To fix this issue, it would be necessary to modify the pandas.core.groupby.groupby._GroupBy.apply method to handle nullable integer columns more robustly.
